doc: Sets the D_800737C0 busy/lock flag to 1, enters a critical section, calls the RCnt helper StopRCnt(0xF2000002) (hardware timer 2), leaves the critical section, then clears the D_80085F98 mode flag and the D_800737C0 lock flag back to 0.
